digest.component_or_area: Ticket store completion verification and pinned read-only view
propositions: Full ticket-store materialization currently consumes 135-235 seconds for 5,500 directories and 132,000 files; pinned git-based read using commit OID can complete scoped single-ticket extraction and reduction in ~29ms, approximately 4,600-8,000x faster
Pinned reads at a captured commit OID remain byte-identical while live mutations advance HEAD, proving stable isolated reads concurrent with normal store mutations
Alias-linked tickets require pinned resolver context (sibling namespace or global bindings) to resolve canonically; isolated target-only extraction retains unresolved alias references

Completion workflow currently combines pinned code with live-checkout ticket inputs, mixed pinned and live prefetch inputs, and later-signing material, risking invalid evidence binding across read versions

Validation must track exact ticket reads, membership predicates, hierarchy/link changes, global resolver state, and negative existence; simple target-tree equality or whole-HEAD equality is insufficient to catch structural invalidation
